_README: Ratchet for the post-guard duplicate rate (duplicate-rate-ratchet.test.ts).
Duplicate rate = surplus members of merge- or review-band clusters / threats,
scored by services/ai/dedup/duplicate-detector.ts. 'replay' is the committed
llm-journal.json replayed through the pipeline (full features, detector-only
guard: the guard's LLM call is not in the journal). 'seedsMean' is the mean over
The test fails if a measured rate goes ABOVE its ceiling, and also if a ceiling
sits more than SLACK above the measured rate: when a change lowers the rate,
lower the ceiling to the new value in the same commit. Ceilings only go down.
Run `npm run eval:dupes` for the per-seed table.
